text: I took this backpack on a weekend hiking trip, and overall it held up well. The padded straps stayed comfortable even after hours on the trail, with no shoulder soreness. The side pocket, though, is awkwardly shallow, and my water bottle kept slipping out. The main zipper also caught once on the lining, but it freed easily. Solid pack, minor flaws.
task: Write a fictional first-person review of a backpack after a weekend trip: comfortable straps, awkward side pocket, and a zipper that caught once.
